custom.rebels:
Create a Bullets of Fury production pixel-art HUD sheet with FIVE UNIQUE compact floating enemy HEALTH BARS, one for each Roaming Rebel pilot. Reference image 1 is the actual rebel roster: preserve each pilot's established identity and colors; do not draw the portraits. Reference image 2 is the game's current HUD design style.
Actual transparent background, orthographic front view, crisp Neo-Geo/Sega 32X pixel-metal art. Canvas 1536x1024. Five isolated horizontal bar sprites stacked vertically with generous transparent gutters; all five same overall width, height and track proportions. Each bar should be wide and SHALLOW, approximately 1350x110, with a small centered integrated name tab. Equal rows. No title, no captions, no ships, no additional UI, no backgrounds.
Exact top-to-bottom order and lettering:
1 VOSS: leader's dark iron/red armor with hot-pink fusion accents, angular vulture/command-wing end emblems. Solid hot pink/red-magenta glowing HP fill.
2 NYX: sleek black-violet stealth armor with cyan spiral accents, curved knife/ghost crescent ends. Solid luminous violet HP fill.
3 ROOK: heavy black/orange armor and bolts, grapple-hook/hook-chain motifs on end plates. Solid molten amber/orange HP fill.
4 KAIA: dark teal signal-hacker armor with crisp circuit traces and radio-wave end emblems. Solid turquoise/teal HP fill.
5 JACE: angular crimson interceptor armor with razor/swept-wing ends, more aggressive slim silhouette. Solid scarlet red HP fill.
All five fill tracks are simple straight horizontal rectangles: filled about 65% from the left, with plain black unfilled remainder on the right. The fill has a bright internal highlight, completely continuous SOLID glow: NO cells, no segments, no tick marks, no === pattern. Keep the frame thin enough for readable HP at small in-game size. The names are centered on the small dark upper name tabs, high contrast, exact spelling. All FIVE bars are HP ONLY: no shield line, no empty secondary socket. They will float above their own ships, so keep them compact and individually identifiable. Different endcap art per pilot, no repeated caution stripes, no giant decorative wings. Maintain clean transparent outside silhouettes.
custom.harrier:
Create a Bullets of Fury HARRIER boss-health-bar asset pair. Reference 1 is the ACTUAL Harrier/Warhive carrier ship: use its dark gunmetal plate armor, broad angular wings, circular turbine fans, inset center hatch and silver bevels as the bar's visual identity. Reference 2 is the current coastal-city HUD kit, used only for pixel style and bar proportions. Do NOT draw ships or the player HUD.
True transparent canvas, approximately 1536x512, with TWO separate very wide shallow horizontal boss bars stacked vertically and comfortable transparent gutters. Both have exact word "HARRIER" on an integrated small centered dark name tab.
Upper bar: health with a thin cyan secondary shield track beneath it.
Lower bar: health only, a shallower housing with NO shield line and NO extra socket.
Dark gunmetal/silver armor frame. At each end, circular TURBINE FAN emblems derived from the reference ship; short angular Harrier wing plates connecting them to the rail. Restrained royal-blue/white status lights and tiny amber engine details. No city skyline, anchor, snow, caution stripes or generic hazard labels. Unique aircraft-carrier identity.
HP fill is luminous steel/royal blue with a pale blue-white inner highlight, 70% full, plain dark remainder. Shield is a much thinner bright cyan continuous fill, 50% full. All long meters are smooth SOLID unbroken filled energy strips, NO cells, no ticks, no == styling. High readability at small game size, authored Neo-Geo/Sega32X pixel clusters, thin metal frame, flat straight-on view. Exact two components only, no title, no extra text, no background.
